name: ELLIOT, the Hon. Maria Justine (Justine)

headline.note: Queensland Police and the NSW Department of Juvenile Justice are documented public employers, but only year-level boundaries and no substantive full-time evidence are available. Study, party activity and elected office are excluded. The 1997–2002 and 2003–2004 intervals remain unresolved; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Bachelor of Arts student (English and history)
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography, citing parliamentary material, records a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Queensland with English and history majors. Enrolment dates, load, completion date and employment overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract records police service from 1990 to 1997. Her current first-party biography describes front-line police work, and the secondary biography identifies Queensland Police. Exact appointment and cessation dates, rank, postings, hours, leave and any study overlap are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public employment is supported, but year-only boundaries and absent substantive full-time evidence do not establish an exact countable interval.

career_spells.role: Graduate Diploma in Human Resource Management and Industrial Relations student
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography records this Griffith University qualification. Dates, study load and overlap with police or later work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Member from 1995; Tweed Coast branch president, 2003–2004
career_spells.evidence_note: The secondary biography, citing parliamentary and party material, records party membership from 1995 and branch presidency from 2003 to 2004. Exact term dates, remuneration, hours and overlaps are unresolved; governance is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract names the department and role and gives 2002–2003 boundaries. Exact appointment and cessation dates, employment basis, hours, leave and overlap with party activity are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Public employment is supported, but year-only boundaries and absent substantive full-time evidence do not establish an exact countable interval.

career_spells.role: Member for Richmond; ministerial and parliamentary-secretary duties during elected service
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster establishes House service from 9 October 2004. Current first-party and secondary biographies corroborate continuing representation; ministerial duties are nested within the elected-office spell.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The frozen official record documents two public-service spells but supplies only year-level boundaries and no hours.
The current member biography corroborates police work but does not supply dates or full-time status.
No unsupported occupation is inserted for the five-year interval after police service or the interval before election.
Ministerial roles after 2004 are nested within elected service and do not form additional headline employment.
open_questions: What were the exact Queensland Police appointment, posting, rank, hours, leave and cessation details?
What work, family-care or other activity occurred between police service in 1997 and Juvenile Justice work in 2002?
What were the dates and study loads for both tertiary qualifications, and how did they overlap employment?
What were the exact Juvenile Justice appointment, employment basis, hours, leave and cessation details?
What paid work or campaign activity occurred from the 2003 role ending until election on 9 October 2004?
Was the Tweed Coast branch presidency remunerated, and how did it overlap public employment and campaigning?
